meta.name: bug-reproduction-test-generator
meta.description: Automatically generates executable tests that reproduce reported bugs from issue reports and code repositories. Use when users need to: (1) Create a test that reproduces a bug described in an issue report, (2) Generate failing tests from bug descriptions, stack traces, or error messages, (3) Validate bug reports by creating reproducible test cases, (4) Convert issue reports into executable regression tests. Takes a repository and issue report as input and produces test code that reliably triggers the reported bug.

copy.tagline: 把 bug 报告变成可执行的测试代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要根据 issue 报告编写可复现的测试用例。
